text: I'm sorry to hear you're feeling this way. To better understand your condition, have you noticed any changes in your stool color or urine output recently? Also, do you have a history of liver disease or heavy alcohol consumption?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your age and the unintentional weight loss, have you experienced any itching (pruritus) or abdominal pain? Additionally, have you noticed your urine becoming dark or your stool appearing pale?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your symptoms of jaundice, weight loss, and fatigue, I need to assess for signs of biliary obstruction. Have you noticed any fever, chills, or right upper quadrant abdominal pain? Also, have you had any recent skin rashes or mouth sores?

REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Panel (ALT, AST, ALP, Bilirubin, Albumin, INR), Complete Blood Count (CBC).

text: RESULTS: Liver Function Tests: AST - Elevated, ALT - Elevated, ALP - Significantly elevated, Bilirubin - Elevated, Albumin - Not reported, INR - Not reported; CBC: WBC - Normal, Hemoglobin - Normal, Platelets - Normal; Ultrasound Abdomen: Enlarged, thin-walled gallbladder. No evident stones.
